skill.name: nextjs-on-cloudflare
skill.description: Build, migrate, and deploy Next.js apps on Cloudflare Workers with vinext. Use when starting a Next.js project on Cloudflare, moving an existing app to Workers, choosing between vinext and OpenNext, or setting up vinext for Workers. For setup, migration, or deployment, install vinext's upstream skills with `npx skills add cloudflare/vinext` if missing, then read and follow the applicable skill and docs.
skill.summary: Guide Next.js projects through vinext setup, migration, and deployment on Cloudflare Workers.
skill.author: cloudflare

security_audit.summary: Three command-related findings are confirmed because the skill directs agents to run external packages for installation and project creation. Documentation links, inline identifiers, and remote .agents paths are false positives, but the mutable upstream delegation creates a separate supply-chain risk.

remediation.issue: The workflow installs and follows upstream skills without an immutable version or commit.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the vinext skill and package to reviewed versions, show the resolved source, and require user confirmation before installation or execution.

content.user_title: Deploy Next.js Apps on Cloudflare Workers
content.value_statement: Moving Next.js applications to Cloudflare Workers requires current compatibility and deployment guidance. This skill selects vinext workflows for new projects, migrations, development, and deployment.
actual_capabilities: Recommends vinext for new Next.js projects targeting Cloudflare Workers.
Distinguishes new-project setup from existing-project migration.
Directs existing projects to vinext compatibility checks and migration guidance.
Points development and deployment work to current Workers integration documentation.
Preserves existing OpenNext configurations during unrelated maintenance.
Identifies App Router, Pages Router, server components, and Vite tooling as supported areas.
limitations: The skill does not guarantee complete Next.js API compatibility.
Detailed setup and migration steps depend on external vinext skills and documentation.
It does not audit application code, bindings, secrets, or Cloudflare account configuration.
External package installation requires network access and user approval.

use_cases.title: Start a Workers Project
use_cases.description: Create a new Next.js application with vinext and select Cloudflare Workers as the deployment target.
use_cases.target_user: Frontend developer starting a Cloudflare project

use_cases.title: Migrate an Existing Application
use_cases.description: Assess compatibility and move an established Next.js project to vinext without treating an empty directory as a migration.
use_cases.target_user: Application engineer maintaining a Next.js codebase

use_cases.title: Standardize Deployment Guidance
use_cases.description: Apply current vinext and Workers documentation while preserving existing OpenNext choices during unrelated work.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Project Path
prompt_templates.prompt: I am starting a Next.js application on Cloudflare Workers. Choose the appropriate vinext setup path and list the required decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this existing Next.js project for a vinext migration. Identify compatibility checks, likely blockers, and the Cloudflare target configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve OpenNext
prompt_templates.prompt: Update this Cloudflare Next.js project without replacing its existing OpenNext setup. Explain which changes remain within the requested maintenance scope.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Deployment Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a vinext development and deployment plan for this repository. Cover Workers bindings, local workerd testing, compatibility validation, and rollback checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Platform engineer defining an advanced workflow

output_examples.input: Should a new Cloudflare Workers project use vinext or OpenNext?
output_examples.output: Use vinext for a new project unless project requirements or an explicit decision require OpenNext. Confirm required Next.js features before implementation.

output_examples.input: Migrate my existing Next.js application to Cloudflare Workers.
output: Confirm that the repository contains an existing Next.js application.
Run the vinext compatibility assessment and document unsupported features.
Apply the migration workflow with Cloudflare selected as the target.
Test local Workers behavior before deployment.

best_practices: Confirm required Next.js features against current vinext compatibility information.
Preserve an existing OpenNext setup unless the user explicitly requests migration.
Review external skill sources and request approval before installing packages.
anti_patterns: Do not apply the migration workflow to an empty directory.
Do not assume complete parity with every Next.js feature.
Do not replace OpenNext during unrelated maintenance.

faq.question: Which runtime does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Next.js applications running on Cloudflare Workers through vinext.

faq.question: Does it support new projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs new projects to create-vinext-app with Cloudflare selected as the target.

faq.question: Can it migrate an existing Next.js application?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs existing applications through the upstream migration skill and compatibility checks.

faq.question: Will it replace an existing OpenNext setup?
faq.answer: No. It preserves OpenNext during unrelated maintenance unless the user explicitly chooses migration.

faq.question: Does vinext support every Next.js feature?
faq.answer: No guarantee is provided. Check current compatibility for every feature the application requires.

faq.question: Does this skill install external tools?
faq.answer: Its workflow may install upstream vinext skills with npx. Review the source and approve execution before installation.
